artboards.title: Alternative: outline only, colour marks the tab

annotations.text:
Issue #80 — bottom tab icons + trash can. Nothing else in the tab bar changes: same height, labels, colours and hairline as the approved canvas.

Recommended: Ionicons. At rest a tab shows the outline glyph in grey; the selected tab switches to the filled glyph in its own colour (Today amber, Workout violet, Charts blue, Settings white/ink). Shape + colour, so it reads in bad light and for colour-blind users.

Alternative (right, row 2): keep the outline and change colour only — lighter, but the selected tab is harder to spot at a glance.

Trash can: filled "trash" glyph centred in a square red button (36 pt, touch area 44 pt), on the row's trailing edge. A 10 pt gap of background separates it from the protein figure; the row slides open by 46 pt. Light theme: white on red (6.1:1). Dark theme: near-black on coral (6.7:1) — approved.
